title: uiflow-micropython #130: webrepl hardcodes ws://uiflow2.m5stack.com, ignores uiflow/server NVS and starts unconditionally

execution.environment: macOS; local clone of m5stack/uiflow-micropython plus GitHub contents API; public 2.5.4 release assets; no device, no emulator, no build

checks.name: endpoint_is_hardcoded
checks.evidence: webrepl.c:27 defines ws://uiflow2.m5stack.com/ws/realtime?role=device&mac=%s; webrepl_build_uri() 110-126 substitutes only the MAC

checks.name: webrepl_has_no_nvs_access
checks.evidence: no nvs.h include and no nvs_* call in webrepl.c at master; nvs.h was removed by 05c2ca20

checks.name: nvs_server_key_used_before_regression
checks.evidence: 7a5f7598 webrepl.c:128-147 opens the uiflow namespace and reads the server key; 05c2ca20 removed that path; partition_nvs.csv:3 still sets server=uiflow2.m5stack.com

checks.name: factory_nvs_default_is_cloud_host
checks.evidence: partition_nvs.csv:3 server=uiflow2.m5stack.com; Makefile:204 includes the generated nvs.bin in pack_fw, i.e. in the merged release image

checks.name: runtime_gate_removed
checks.evidence: 05c2ca20 deleted webrepl_read_server() and webrepl_should_start(); grep for either symbol in m5stack/ returns nothing

checks.name: m5things_comparison_availability
checks.evidence: m5stack/components/m5things is absent from the public GitHub tree at 2.5.0..2.5.4, master and 7a5f7598, so the issue's m5things comparison could not be checked publicly

checks.name: original_gate_was_single_host_allowlist
checks.evidence: 7a5f7598 webrepl.c:144-147 compares uiflow/server to aiflow.m5stack.com; with the factory default the task never started

checks.name: task_starts_unconditionally
checks.evidence: main.c:319-321 creates webrepl_task under #if WEB_REPL_ENABLE with no runtime check

checks.name: board_scope
checks.evidence: CMakeListsDefault.cmake:175-178 defaults WEB_REPL_ENABLE to 0; 13 of 56 board directories at public master set it to 1

checks.name: ctrl_c_interrupt_path
checks.evidence: 0x03 calls mp_sched_keyboard_interrupt() at 200-205 when the REPL enabled the interrupt char

checks.name: no_tls
checks.evidence: scheme is ws:// in webrepl.c:27; zero wss:// strings in both 2.5.4 images

checks.name: no_client_credentials
checks.evidence: esp_websocket_client_config_t 455-466 sets no headers, token, username or password; MAC is the only identifier

checks.name: released_images_contain_endpoint
checks.evidence: strings match the URI template plus webrepl_task/webrepl_ws in both 2.5.4 images (hashes in firmware.images)

checks.name: runtime_injection_reproduction
checks.evidence: would require injecting a clientMessage into the production channel or an on-path proxy; not performed

checks.name: device_or_emulator_boot
checks.evidence: retail build logs at default level; no runtime marker would be visible and the source facts are already established

checks.name: server_side_auth_and_mac_validation
checks.evidence: server implementation is not in this repository

checks.name: web_ide_opt_in_check
checks.evidence: UIFlow2 web front end not inspected; the device has no local opt-in

evidence.description: numbered source excerpts from GitHub master for webrepl.c and main.c
pre-regression gated implementation with the single-host allow-list
blob hashes by tag, commit IDs, board enablement count, residual gate grep
2.5.4 asset hashes, URI and task-name strings, wss:// count

notes: The report's three claims are confirmed at code level; two scope statements are corrected (the old gate was a single-host allow-list, and 13 of 56 public board directories enable the component).
Plaintext ws:// plus no client credential means an on-path party can forge a clientMessage; whether MAC impersonation is possible depends on the server and is NOT VERIFIED.
The issue's m5things comparison is not used as evidence because that component is not published in the public repository; the uiflow/server key is proven by the removed webrepl code at 7a5f7598.
The fixed developer MAC from 05c2ca20 is intentionally omitted from this record.
No device, emulator, build or server was executed; all runtime checks are marked NOT RUN.
